name: time-fire-close
eval: bend.set('camera', { followDist: 2.3, followFov: 40, followPitch: 0.1, followSwing: 0 }); bend.wake(); bend.place(0, 0, 0, Math.PI/2); bend.camera({ yaw: 0.25 });

name: time-forge-clash
eval: bend.wake(); bend.lock(true); await bend.step(120); const L=(bend.rig.plane?.ledges??[]).filter(l=>!l.bob).slice().sort((a,b)=>a.x0-b.x0); const cs=bend.show.dancers.map(d=>d.controller).filter(c=>c.kind==='intent'); if(L.length){ const a=L[0], b=L[L.length-1]; cs[0].character.reset((a.x0+a.x1)/2, a.y+0.15); cs[1].character.reset((b.x0+b.x1)/2, b.y+0.15);} else { bend.place(0,-2.4,0); bend.place(1,2.4,0);}
